def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    mask = bins >= item
    priorities = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)
    eps = 1e-12
    p = 2.0
    priorities[mask] = -np.log((bins[mask] - item + eps) ** p)
    return priorities

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    mask = bins >= item
    priorities = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)
    eps = 1e-12
    k = 1.5
    priorities[mask] = -np.log(k * (bins[mask] - item) + eps)
    return priorities

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    mask = bins >= item
    priorities = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)
    if np.any(mask):
        remaining = bins[mask] - item
        priorities[mask] = np.exp(-remaining / item) / (bins[mask] + 1e-12)
    return priorities

    mask = bins >= item

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    mask = bins >= item
    priorities = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)
    priorities[mask] = (bins[mask] - item) // item
